summary: Iteration 21 regression: verified categorizBookings() in AdminDashboard.js now buckets status='pending_payment' bookings into New/Upcoming/InProgress bins alongside 'scheduled'. Seeded 6 test bookings (pp_today, pp_tomorrow, sched_today, sched_tomorrow, in_progress, pending_customer_approval) and confirmed each landed in the intended bin. Upcoming BinModal renders the pending_payment tomorrow booking with a 'PENDING PAYMENT' badge and full Route/Start Job/Complete/+Photo action buttons. Regression on all other buckets and modal action-button gates from iter20 remains intact.
action_items: Optional UX note (not a bug): the 'New' tile in the bin row wires to openCalendar(), not openBin('new'). The review request phrased the check as "click 'New' tile → BinModal opens with today's pending_payment booking", but clicking 'New' actually opens the Calendar modal. Today's pending_payment bookings ARE now counted in the 'New' tile badge (categorizBookings fix works), and admins can drill into any of them via Calendar → today's cell → openJobDetails → BinModal (which correctly renders the Start Job button per iter20 fix). If product wants the 'New' tile to open BinModal directly instead of the Calendar, that's a separate 1-line change: `else if (bin.type === 'new') { openBin('new'); }`.
critical_code_review_comments: categorizBookings() line 784 now correctly widens the 'scheduled OR pending_payment' gate — no other bin logic touched. Confirmed via tile counts: Upcoming shows exactly the 2 seeded tomorrow bookings (1 pending_payment + 1 scheduled).
seed_data_creation: Seeded via /tmp/seed_iter21.py (TEST_ITER21 tag): pp_today, pp_tomorrow, sched_today, sched_tomorrow, in_progress, pending_customer_approval. All 12 records (6 bookings + 6 quotes) cleaned up post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter21 fix (categorizBookings bucketing of pending_payment) is verified end-to-end. Upcoming BinModal properly shows pending_payment jobs with a red 'PENDING PAYMENT' badge and all action buttons (Route/Start Job/Complete/+Photo). approved_price fallback from iter20 continues to render correctly ($350 shown in Job Details for the pp_today card via All Jobs → click path). Only remaining verified caveat: 'New' tile still opens Calendar (unchanged behavior); admin reaches today's pending_payment jobs via Calendar drill-in, not directly. See action_items for the optional wire-up.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug was: categorizBookings() previously gated on `status === 'scheduled'` only, so pending_payment bookings were counted in NO bin (new/upcoming/inProgress showed stale zero for that status). Fix (line 784) widens gate to `status === 'scheduled' || status === 'pending_payment'`. Verified today→New bucket, future→Upcoming bucket, past→New bucket (fallback branch). No regression on pending_customer_approval (still lands in New via prior branch on line 782) or in_progress (line 780).
